transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, hi. Um... mostly just... people keep telling me I'm not listening. Like my wife, or my supervisor at work. They'll be talking straight to me, and... I don't know, a minute later I realize I only caught half of it. Then I have to ask them to say it again. That's... pretty much why I'm here.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with paying attention?

Uh... I guess about two years. Maybe two years and two months. It... it just got this bad around then. My wife started working outside the house, and... I had to handle more of the schedule on my own. So... yeah. Since then.
Did you have similar problems with paying attention or staying organized when you were a child in school?

Yeah... I guess I was kind of like this back then, too. Um... teachers were always moving my seat around. Said I couldn't stay put. I'd... call out answers a lot. Or get in trouble for butting into other kids' work. That was... mostly before middle school, though. So, yeah.
Nowadays as an adult, do you often feel restless or have trouble sitting still?

Uh... yeah. I guess. 

Sitting still is... it's not great. I just get this... I don't know, this pressure. Like it builds up inside my chest, and my legs. It just feels like I have to do something, or move, right that second. Or else I'll... I don't know, crawl out of my skin. So... yeah.
Do you often find yourself interrupting people or finishing their sentences before they can finish?

Yeah... I guess so. 

Um... like at work, in our meetings. I'll just... answer before the supervisor is even done asking the question. Sometimes I'm already talking and... I realize I didn't even let him get to the important part. So... yeah. I do that.
